summary: Design, file mapping, instrument (QE HF confirmed from raw header) and search parameters are correct. FAIL on one important issue: required Cellosaurus accession is 'not available' although SW480 is CVCL_0546 (cited in the producer's own manifest).

reviewer_context.context: fresh reviewer subagent; no producer transcript; annotations/<PXD>.report.md, results/reviews/ and producer scratch files (samples.tsv, technical.tsv, validate_*.txt) not read

spec_compliance.evidence: Templates ms-proteomics + human + cell-lines v1.1.0 match content (human cell line). Required columns present, 18 rows, unique assay names/files, valid mod syntax, ms1 scan range present.

ontology_integrity.evidence: OLS/sdrf-tools check 14/14 verified: MONDO:0002271 colon adenocarcinoma (= Cellosaurus NCIt C4349), colon, epithelial cell, MS:1002523 Q Exactive HF, HCD MS:1000422, Trypsin, DTT/IAA PRIDE terms, UNIMOD:4/35.

source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE protocols + Proteome Sci 2022 (PMID 35578244) checked. Treatments 10 nM R9VH36 / gefitinib 1 h, triplicate flasks, top10 HCD, 400-1600 m/z, PD 2.4 20 ppm / 0.01 Da, carbamidomethyl fixed / ox M variable, DTT/IAA confirmed. Raw header (first 8 MB of con1_cyt1.raw, HTTPS range request) reads 'Q Exactive HF - Orbitrap MS'. Cellosaurus CVCL_0546: male, NCIt colon adenocarcinoma, age 51Y. Cellosaurus accession value contradicts available evidence.

file_mapping.evidence: PRIDE files.json has 18 RAW .raw files, all mapped exactly once; the mzML (PEAK) and mzid.gz (RESULT) for VH3b3_cyt2 are derived files and correctly excluded.

design_consistency.evidence: 3 treatments (con, VH3b=R9VH36, gefitinib) x 3 biological replicates x 2 runs (cyt1/cyt2) = 18 runs, matching paper 'across all runs; n = 18'. cyt1/cyt2 as technical injections is inferred from names (no fractionation described) and disclosed in the manifest.

omission_safety.evidence: No unsupported additions; omission of the required Cellosaurus accession that is available (and cited in the manifest).

deterministic_validation.evidence: parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics -t human -t cell-lines: exit 0, warnings only (free-text treatment values); sdrf-tools check: CLEAN (0 hallucinated/mismatch); sdrf-tools score run (97-98/100).

findings.message: Required column set to 'not available' although the accession exists. Set to CVCL_0546 (and add characteristics[cellosaurus name] SW480).
findings.evidence: Cellosaurus API CVCL_0546: ID SW480, Homo sapiens, Male, 51Y, colon adenocarcinoma. The evidence manifest claim itself reads 'SW480 (CVCL_0546)'. cell-lines template: required, format CVCL_XXXX.

findings.message: Donor age is available from Cellosaurus (51Y); consider '51Y' instead of 'not available'.

The paper also states 'The IC50 of testing samples was used in the proteomics analysis' (IC50 527 nM R9VH36, 13.31 uM gefitinib), conflicting with the explicit '10 nM ... for 1 h'. The 10 nM value follows the explicit sample-prep text; record the conflict in the manifest limitations.
findings.evidence: Proteome Sci 2022 Methods (cell viability vs 'Sample preparation for proteomics analysis'); PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol states 10 nM.

findings.message: Recommended cell-lines columns: EMEM is stated; file names carry 'p7' (likely passage 7, unconfirmed).
findings.evidence: Manuscript Cell culture: 'Eagle's Minimum Essential Medium (EMEM) (ATCC, USA) supplemented with 10% ... calf bovine serum'; file names Kiatawi_SW480_p7_*.
